name: Electric Reliability Council of Texas
summary: Electric Reliability Council of Texas appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The plant is late).

mentions.excerpt: The Electric Reliability Council of Texas, ERCOT, reported about 438 gigawatts of large-load requests on May 24, against about 452 gigawatts of generation requests, most of the load requests with no study submitted.

sides.claim: ERCOT reports it is tracking roughly 438 GW of Large Load interconnection requests and roughly 452 GW of Generation Interconnection requests.
